name: protein-structure fixtures
code_version_note: the commit at build time, which precedes the commit that lands these files
note: One file per coding gene: that gene's own real AlphaFold alpha-carbon trace, public reference data identical for every human. Nothing here is invented; partners[] is empty because no experimental complex is fetched yet.
patient_data: none. Reference coordinates and amino-acid indices only. The one invented part is gene-structure candidates[], which exists precisely because the proband's alleles are never committed.

inputs.name: ressources/reference/structure_genes.tsv
inputs.role: the curated gene set: which symbols exist and which code

fields.gene: REAL — the gene set's own spelling of the symbol
fields.protein: REAL — the Ensembl translation id the residue axis belongs to
fields.uniprot: REAL — the UniProt accession AlphaFold DB is keyed by
fields.provenance: REAL — which structure database answered, always 'alphafold' today
fields.model_url: REAL — the exact mmCIF that was parsed
fields.version: REAL — the model's latestVersion, read from the API reply
fields.protein_length: REAL — Ensembl's translation length, the axis of record
fields.residues: REAL — alpha-carbon coordinates and pLDDT from the mmCIF, re-rounded
fields.covered: REAL — which residue ranges the model actually contains
fields.secondary: REAL — _struct_conf helix/strand segments from the mmCIF
fields.partners: EMPTY — phase 2; no experimental complex is fetched, so it is always []
